title: Automated media power and data transfer

specimens.name: Recessed power comb
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Horizontal side cutaway of one partially docked electrical coupling. Left housing has three broad copper blades facing right. Right housing has three matching recessed copper contacts facing left. Show BOTH banks clearly, with an uninterrupted vertical dark air gap between every opposing pair. Along the TOP of both housings, a long pale tapered alignment tongue is already inserted into its funnel, spanning the gap. The guide is visibly longer than the contacts. No loose pieces, cables or glow. Make outer carrier a replaceable robotic service cassette with asymmetric chamfered alignment socket and two recessed captive mounting seats. One compact fixed proximity pickup faces a flat target on opposing moving housing across gap, exposing partial-dock detection. Contacts remain separated, alignment tongue engaged before contacts. No complete docking station.

specimens.name: Dual coolant face coupling
specimens.description: R1C2. Preserve whole coupling and upper pressure chamber exactly. Replace ONLY middle 25 pixels of upper horizontal round piston rod under amber sensor with ONE rectangular raised silver target block. Block has flat top and vertical sides; it remains mechanically joined to rod on left and right. Block top is at least 8 pixels BELOW sensor bottom with clear dark empty gap. Block is wider than sensor and twice the rod diameter tall. Preserve blue chamber, full-height sealed piston at left and dry spring at right. No other edits.

specimens.name: Vacuum service bell
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Horizontal-axis SIDE SECTION. LEFT: small vacuum tube. MIDDLE: bell flares outward from small tube to wide end on RIGHT. RIGHT: flat vertical pale bulkhead plate extending beyond both wide bell edges. Two dark compressed rubber beads on the wide bell rim directly touch the LEFT face of plate, one above and one below. One centered axial through-hole in plate, shown in section. No plate on the narrow end.

specimens.name: Optical data feedthrough
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One unmated D-shaped keyed optical nose, facing viewer. Cross-section like a capital D with one straight vertical edge on left and one continuous semicircular curved edge on right. Exactly two recessed glass windows and one perimeter seal follow D outline. No octagon, no pins. Show the unmated D nose recessed inside a shallow protective carrier with a clearly asymmetrical tapered guide shoulder ahead of the windows. Preserve exactly two glass windows and a D seal.

specimens.name: Leak witness annulus
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One isolated atomic fragment. One double-wall tube crossing one bulkhead; cutaway shows annular collection cavity and single radial witness outlet.

specimens.name: Spiral rotary ribbon
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Completely discard old double-band geometry. Copy the single thin amber open spiral trajectory from the second input, including exactly two visibly separate endpoint clamps and the entire unbranched line between them. Render that trajectory as ONE flexible ribbon on edge in a dark shallow rotary tray. No additional gold path anywhere in this cell. Leave negative space between turns. Match pixel art of sheet.

specimens.name: Closed branch spool
specimens.description: R2C3. Keep closed spool, radial ports, seals and left spring. Right chamber left-to-right: fixed dark steel annular pole visibly joined to housing roof and floor; narrow open axial gap; rectangular silver moving armature. Thin silver stem runs through center hole in pole and across gap to armature, with empty gap above and below stem. Copper coil surrounds pole and armature. The fixed pole attracts moving armature left, opposing the return spring. Right end is nonmagnetic closed stop. No other changes.

specimens.name: Slit lubrication septum
specimens.description: R2C4. Preserve slit septum closed at LEFT, blunt cannula retracted with clear gap, gold moving carriage and return spring at RIGHT. REMOVE solid upper bridge touching carriage. On carriage top place one short flat silver target. Directly ABOVE target mount small amber pickup rigidly on housing roof. Wide dark empty horizontal air slit separates pickup bottom and target top, at least half pickup height. No metal connection across slit. Preserve mounting key and service socket.
